title: Time to unplug

slides.title: Pim roosts at dusk
slides.text: Pim delivers post all day, over every road in Netville. But at dusk Pim roosts, because every creature has an off-duty time, even post owls.
slides.alt: Pim the owl: a round brown owl with big eyes, a cream belly and a tiny backpack.

focus.cue: Pim the owl, off duty at dusk

slides.title: Your body sends signs
slides.text: Your body tells you when play stops feeling good. Sore eyes, a heavy head and grumpy feelings are signs. So is a looping thought: just one more, just one more.
slides.alt: A Would You Rather technology dilemma: two inventions to choose between, and reasons to weigh on both sides.

focus.cue: Computers that only play songs people wrote

slides.title: Choose the stop before you start
slides.text: The Defender trick is simple: choose your stopping point before you start playing. A stop you chose early is much easier to keep than one you invent mid-game.
slides.alt: Packet Post's title screen: Pim the owl at the Netville post office. Deliver every packet. Keep every secret.

focus.cue: Choose the stop before you press play
Pim, at the post office, done for the day

slides.title: The Magpie's long evening
slides.text: Yesterday the Magpie kept tapping just one more on a shiny game until the stars came out. Read the signs the Magpie missed.
steps: Eyes sore from the bright screen
Too tired to enjoy the game
Just one more, again and again
A break would have felt better
slides.alt: Would you rather ask a trusted adult before every download, or never download anything at all?

focus.cue: Ask a trusted adult before every download
Or never download anything at all

slides.title: Better breaks
slides.text: A break is not empty time. Drawing, building, fresh air and a snack all recharge you in ways a screen cannot. Netville keeps a Noticeboard of Better Breaks by the post office door.
slides.alt: Five packets for the zoo: every road on this map meets at the center office, where many hands can carry them.

focus.cue: Every road meets at the center office
Five packets cross here: the whole town in one map

words.means: a healthy mix of screen time and other things
a pause that rests your body and mind
something you do often, almost without thinking
days in a row that a game counts and praises

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: There is no game this time. Add one idea to the Noticeboard of Better Breaks, and set your own one-week break plan with a stopping point you choose first.
slides.alt: Five packets for the zoo: every road on this map meets at the center office, where many hands can carry them.

focus.cue: Meet at the center office and make your break plan

talk: What is your favorite break when a game stops feeling good, and how do you know it is time to take it?
